title: TDMRep AI-Training Reservation Builder
description: Builds a W3C TDM Reservation Protocol /.well-known/tdmrep.json plus the HTML meta and HTTP header equivalents to reserve (opt out of) or open text and data mining and AI training rights on content, with optional TDM policy URL and ISCC soft-binding. The machine-readable AI-training opt-out the EU AI Act expects GPAI providers to honour. Deterministic, client-side, zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_tdm_reservation
mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds a W3C TDMRep tdmrep.json rule array plus the HTML meta tag and HTTP header equivalents to reserve (tdm-reservation:1) or open (0) text and data mining and AI training rights for a content path, with an optional tdm-policy URL. Deterministic string generation. Use to declare an AI-training opt-out under the EU AI Act GPAI regime.
